'''Viper Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Viper, [[Striker Squadron (Sith Empire)|Striker]], and [[Talon Squadron (Sith Empire)|Talon]] Squadrons were shot down by the [[Balmorran resistance]]. However, the survivors were rescued from the resistance by Imperial forces.
